raw_segments.text: Great friends with Rakuten? No, not as much as that. Is it likely a pig like that? He
considers I am a blaggard. They can't understand a joke either, that's the worst of such
people. They never understand a joke, and their souls are dry, dry and flat. They remind
me of prison walls when I was first brought here. But he is a clever fellow, very clever.
Well, Alexei, it's all over with me now."
